# WP4b: scenario-approach bound on the linearised AC model error

N independent benign states per grid, uniform over the envelope (configuration uniform; non-benign draws rejected). With confidence at least 1 - beta = 0.999, the probability that a new benign state drawn the same way has an error above the sample maximum is at most epsilon = 1 - beta^(1/N). The robust exact layer uses delta (adversarial worst case x 1.25); where delta >= sample maximum, the guarantee holds for delta as well. The guarantee is relative to the sampling distribution; it is not a worst-case proof.
